gloss: to remake; to redo; to make over

definitions.gloss: to remake; to redo; to make over again
definitions.explanation: To make something again from scratch or to substantially rework it, typically because the original was unsatisfactory or needs updating.

examples.japanese: {最初|さいしょ}から{作|つく}り{直|なお}す。
{書類|しょるい}に{間違|まちが}いがあったので{作|つく}り{直|なお}した。
examples.english: There was a mistake in the document, so I redid it.

examples.japanese: この{棚|たな}は{古|ふる}くなったから、{新|あたら}しい{木材|もくざい}で{作|つく}り{直|なお}そう。
examples.english: This shelf has gotten old, so let's rebuild it with new lumber.

notes:
A compound verb combining {作|つく}る (to make) and {直|なお}す (to fix/redo). The {直|なお}す auxiliary indicates doing the action over again, typically to improve or correct the result.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最初|さいしょ}から{作|つく}り{直|なお}す: to remake from scratch
- {一|いち}から{作|つく}り{直|なお}す: to redo from the beginning
- {計画|けいかく}を{作|つく}り{直|なお}す: to redo a plan
- {料理|りょうり}を{作|つく}り{直|なお}す: to remake a dish

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {書|か}き{直|なお}す: to rewrite — specifically for writing
- やり{直|なお}す: to redo — more general, not limited to making/creating
- {立|た}て{直|なお}す: to rebuild, to reorganize — often used for plans, health, or organizations
